# **1\. Business Brief**

**Objective**: To analyse the punctuality and travel speed of bus services in the city of Tartu and to assess the impact of weather conditions on schedule adherence.

**Stakeholders**: Tartu City Government in transport planning

**Key Metrics:**

1) On-Time Performance (%)  
2) Average Delay (min)  
3) Average Driving Speed (km/h)

**Business Questions:**

1) On which bus lines is the average delay (in seconds) greatest during adverse weather conditions (weather phenomena) or heavy rainfall compared to clear weather?

2) Which bus lines are most frequently delayed? Between which stops are the delays greatest?

3) At what times of day are delays greatest? On which days are delays greatest?

4) Which districts (or areas around stops) experience the greatest schedule deviations due to bad weather?

5) To what extent do difficult road sections and weather conditions (e.g., snowfall or rain) slow down traffic in a specific city district or between stops?

# **2\. Datasets**

There are **two** main datasets used in the project: **live bus data** (14 columns) retrieved from [tartu.pilet.ee](http://tartu.pilet.ee) and **live weather data** (19 columns) retrieved from [ilmateenistus.ee](https://www.ilmateenistus.ee/teenused/ilmainfo/eesti-vaatlusandmed-xml/). In addition to this, there are three more tables that supplement the live bus data:

1. Tartu **bus stops** as source for */v1/stops* (8 columns): id, code, name, lat, lon, locationType, interchangePriority, desc

2. Tartu **bus routes** as source for */v1/routes* (6 columns): id, shortName, longName, mode, icon, designation

3. Tartu **bus trip stop schedules** as source for */v1/trips/stoptimes?tripId={TRIP\_ID}* (20 columns): tripId, mode, stopId, stopName, stopPoint, stopIndex, stopCount, scheduledArrival, scheduledDeparture, realtimeArrival, realtimeDeparture, arrivalDelay, departureDelay, timepoint, realtime, headsign, canceled, pickupType, dropOffType, tripDirection

The full overview of the datasets can be found on GitHub (‘[Datasets.md](https://github.com/merettearula1/data-engineering-team-13/blob/main/Datasets.md)’).

# **5\. Data Model**

The star schema model has 2 fact tables and 5 dimension tables.   
![][image2]  
**fact\_bus\_performance**  
Grain: each row represents 1 trip at 1 stop position (stop index) on 1 service date. It contains delays and speed. 

**fact\_weather**   
Grain: each row represents 1 weather observation at 1 station at 1 point in time (every 10-60 minutes). It contains weather measurements. 

The fact tables share the dimensions **dim\_date** and **dim\_time**. Each trip event is linked to the nearest weather observation in time through the key *weather\_key*.

The full Star Schema and the pseudocode SQL for creating tables can be found on GitHub (‘[star\_schema.png](https://github.com/merettearula1/data-engineering-team-13/blob/main/star_schema.png)’ and ‘[star\_schema.sql](https://github.com/merettearula1/data-engineering-team-13/blob/main/star_schema.sql)’). 

**SCD for each dimension:**

| DIM\_DATE | static | Calendar attributes are fixed and do not change. |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| DIM\_TIME | static | Time-of-day attributes are fixed. |
| DIM\_ROUTE | Type 1 | Changes are corrections, where the old value has no analytical use. The fact table stores the measured delays, so overwriting does not change past results. |
| DIM\_TRIP | Type 1 | API regenerates trips when the timetable changes. Can be overwritten, because punctuality of the trip is analysed and not timetable history. |
| DIM\_STOP | Type 2 | Stops can be moved or renamed \- delays must be tied to the stops as it was at the time. Each fact row references the stop version valid at the event time. |

# **6\. Data Dictionary**

The full Data Dictionary can be found on GitHub (‘[Data\_dictionary.md](https://github.com/merettearula1/data-engineering-team-13/blob/main/Data_dictionary.md)’).

| Table | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| FACT\_BUS\_PERFORMANCE | Preprocessed data that is taken from STAGING\_BUS\_LIVE and STAGING\_BUS\_SCHEDULE where 1 row represents 1 trip at 1 stop position. |
| FACT\_WEATHER | Weather observations associated with a station and observation time. |
| DIM\_DATE | Dates used to group performance records by date. |
| DIM\_TIME | Time used to group performance records by time of day. |
| DIM\_ROUTE | A table of all routes in the Tartu bus network. |
| DIM\_TRIP | All trips taking place on all routes. |
| DIM\_STOP | A table of all bus stops in the Tartu bus network. |
| STAGING\_BUS\_LIVE | Raw realtime observations of buses that is updated about every 5 seconds. |
| STAGING\_BUS\_SCHEDULE | Raw scheduled trip and stop data, to get the stop times. |
